name: tutorial-steps-visual
description: Step-by-step visual walkthrough of all 23 tutorial steps (0-22) with per-step screenshots for visual regression testing. Exercises the tutorial overlay from start through congratulations, capturing each step's UI state, highlight targets, and progress indicator.

expect.note: tutorial_pit grants $80,000 starting cash on a 32x20x32 grid (Level.ts)

steps.description: tutorial_start is registered only in src/main.ts (the browser boot path), not in the shared console command table console-api.ts's createRunner() uses -- command mode reports "Unknown command" here and never actually starts the tutorial overlay, while interaction mode's `command` action reaches the real registered handler and does start it (arming TutorialOverlay's rails and setting state.isPaused = true). Neither is a bug: isPaused doesn't gate the explicit `tick` command, tutorial state has no field in SerializableGameState, and every following step in this file also uses `command` rather than a real click, so the divergence is invisible to every expect block below -- confirmed identical across both modes.

expect.note: proves the time-speed control itself works, independent of the tutorial overlay

The first interaction-mode run confirmed this: `survey`'s tile-select confirm was inert, "blocking" per the tutorial rail, not a missing selector. Reaching each control for real needs the same `waitForTutorialStep` gating tutorial-interactive.json uses between every click, keyed to this file's own stage sequence -- not yet mapped out, left as commands rather than guess at stage ids and risk a false pass.
